additional_info.subject: 0373940 - ID0373940-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / PD 170001314] OCPP Offline CRM:00658000694
additional_info.body:
Hello,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / PD 170001314
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
jzZrXT
Problem Description
: OCPP Offline
Troubleshooting
: Network issue, Network set to manual.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0373940
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
Upon analyzing the logs we identified that there was no network on router so charger was offline on OCPP. Router reboot did not resolve this issue.
We logged in on router remotely and got confirmation that internet state is disconnected, and network is on 3G
We forced LTE connection and then set the network manually for better connection as SIM is in roaming state.
Now we have active Internet connection and network is 4G.
OCPP is now online, please check and confirm.
Let us know if you have any other question regarding this.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav Kumar
